notes: Your entire asset library, right inside Premiere Pro and After Effects. Browse folders, preview any file, and import with one click - no more digging through Explorer.
Click + next to User Library to add your asset folders. Click + next to Categories to group files from different folders into collections like SFX or Overlays.
Hover any video to play it, any audio to hear it with its waveform and length badge. Even ProRes, transparent MOVs and MKVs play - the plugin converts them automatically in the background.
Double-click any file to import it into your open project, or drag it straight onto the timeline. Works in Premiere Pro and After Effects.
Select clips on your timeline, press + Add to Library, pick a folder. The files move there and your timeline relinks itself - nothing goes offline.
Right-click any folder for a color. Select files to give them color labels, then sort by Color to group everything visually.
Sort by name, date, type, length or color. The Filters menu and search box narrow ten thousand files down to the one you need.

Open Settings (bottom of the sidebar) to switch file formats on or off, move the cache anywhere, or pre-generate thumbnails for big libraries. The first visit builds the cache - every visit after is instant.
Updates install themselves with one button from the banner - no downloads, no reinstalls. Questions or ideas? Use the Support the creator button below.
